description.value: Kersley General Store is a rural general store serving the small community of Kersley in BC's Cariboo region, one of the few supply points along this sparsely populated stretch of interior BC. For touring cyclists riding through the Cariboo, it represents a potentially critical resupply stop in an area where services are widely spaced. The store's general merchandise character suggests it stocks a range of everyday goods for locals and travellers alike.
